name: Climbing Harness
text:
[FIT] + [exploration] (use 1 piton): Climb the terrain to choose an ascent. Then choose options equal to your effort (you may choose an option multiple times):
Add 2[progress] to that ascent.
Exhaust that ascent if it is a feature.
Move your [ranger] to that ascent.

flavor: Oz gave you this pair of snowshoes after you helped him make a snowman outside the Terra Lodge. With a simple gesture, the soles of the snowshoes come alive, splitting into separate fragments held together by microgravitons.
name: Memlev Snowshoes
text: Exhaust (use 1 charge): Add 2[progress] to an obstacle.

name: Nimbus Spirit
text:
Friendly. Persistent. Unique. Spirit.
[FOC] + [exploration]: Observe the weather patterns to add [progress] to this being equal to your effort. Then scout 1 path card.
sun_challenge: You may exhaust this spirit and discard 3[progress] from him to add 1 token to or discard 1 token from the weather.

flavor: All lives end, but we live on in the memories of those we leave behind. Though you never met this shaper in life, you'll forever hold the memory of his final manifestation in your mind.
name: Aspect of the Elk
text:
Attach to a spirit or companion.
Exhaust: Ready the attached being or add 2[progress] to it.

flavor: You've still only scratched the surface of what this device is truly capable of.
name: Extraspatial Veil
text:
Response: After the weather flips, add 1 shift to this gear.
Use 1 shift: Before a challenge effect on the weather would resolve, cancel that effect.

name: Terra Lodge
text:
Effigies attached to Terra Lodge are not considered to be path cards, and lose all of their traits, types, text, and challenge effects.
Response: Once per day, when you travel, each Ranger chooses and shuffles 1 card from their discard pile into their deck for each effigy attached to this location.
path_deck_assembly: Search the Terra Lodge set for each non-human being and attach them faceup to this location as effigies. <f>(Note: Until you record an effigy, there will be no non-human beings in this set. Record effigies at the Glade of Effigies to add more.)</f>

name: The Otherwoods
text: [FOC] + [reason]: Peer through the veil between worlds to scout cards from the top of the Otherworld deck equal to your effort. Then if your [ranger] is on Shimmering Eaves, you may draw the top card of the Otherworld deck.
path_deck_assembly: Do not add Transdimensional Rift and Entity from Afar to the path deck. Shuffle them together with 6 random cards from the Ravine set and 6 random cards from the Swamp set (other than Heart of the Swamp), then set them next to the path deck. This is the Otherworld deck.

name: Crystal Basin
text: [SPI] + [reason]: Drink from the purified waters to add 1[progress] to this location for every 2 effort. Then soothe an equal amount of fatigue.
arrival_setup: Lead Ranger: Search the path deck for the next feature and put it into play. Next Ranger: Draw 1 path card.

name: Sentinel Peak
text:
Refresh: Discard 1 oxygen from this location. Then, if there is no oxygen on this location, each Ranger suffers 2 fatigue.
Response: After [progress] is added to this location, if its [progress] threshold is reached, you may search the General set for Snow-Capped Summit and put it into play.
path_deck_assembly: Search the Nimbus set for an Icy Path and 3 Deep Fogs, and add them to the path deck.
arrival_setup: Lead Ranger: Search the path deck for the next feature and put it into play. Next Ranger: Search the path deck for the next feature and put it into play.

name: Arbor Mists
text: Each Deep Fog enters play along the way instead of within reach.
path_deck_assembly: Add 3 random cards from the Woods set to the path deck.
arrival_setup: Lead Ranger: Search the path deck for the next mist feature and put it into play. Next Ranger: Search the path deck for the next mist feature and put it into play.

name: The Undergrove
text: [FOC] + [exploration]: Cross [4] the precarious catwalks to move your [ranger] to this location. Increase the difficulty by 1 for each Deep Fog in play. You may discard up to 3[progress] from this location to commit an equal amount of effort.
arrival_setup: Lead Ranger: Draw 1 path card. Next Ranger: Draw 1 path card. Next Ranger: Draw 1 path card.
crest_challenge: If you failed this test, <f>the fog obscures the maze of catwalks.</f> [right_arrow] Move your [ranger] from this location to a Deep Fog in play.

name: Nimbus Facility
arrival_setup: Lead Ranger: Search the path deck for the next feature and put it into play. Next Ranger: Draw 1 path card.
mountain_challenge: Add 1 power to this location. Then if there is 4 or more power on this location, flip the weather and discard all power from this location.

name: Pristine Snow
text:
Path Deck Assembly: Search the General set for a Snowdrift and shuffle it into the path deck.
Refresh: Discard 2 snow from this card. If there is no snow remaining, flip this card.

name: Blizzard
text: [FIT] + [reason]: Shelter [2] from the storm to add 1 snow to this card for every 2 effort. If there is 4 or more snow, flip this card.
sun_challenge: Add 1 snow to this card. [right_arrow] Each Ranger suffers 1 fatigue. Then if there is 4 or more snow, flip this card.
mountain_challenge: Discard 1[progress] from a card along the way.

name: Storm Brewing
text:
An unnatural storm has appeared over the northern reaches of the Valley. With each passing day, it seems to grow larger and larger.
Based on the number of days since you received this mission, the following locations have localized weather (Pristine Snow): 0+ Days: Sentinel Peak, The Undergrove, Arbor Mists, Nimbus Facility 2+ Days: Also; Crystal Basin, Terra Lodge, The Otherwoods 4+ Days: Also; Atrox Mountain, Northern Outpost 6+ Days: Also; Lone Tree Station, Golden Shore, Mount Nim, White Sky
Start of Day: If it has been 10 days since you received this mission, read [guide] 246.2.

name: Storm Brewing
text:
An unnatural storm has appeared over the northern reaches of the Valley. With each passing day, it seems to grow larger and larger.
Based on the number of days since you received this mission, the following locations have localized weather (Pristine Snow): 0+ Days: Sentinel Peak, The Undergrove, Arbor Mists, Nimbus Facility 2+ Days: Also; Crystal Basin, Terra Lodge, The Otherwoods 4+ Days: Also; Atrox Mountain, Northern Outpost 6+ Days: Also; Lone Tree Station, Golden Shore, Mount Nim, White Sky
Start of Day: If it has been 10 days since you received this mission, read [guide] 246.2.

name: To the Summit
text: In order to learn more about the blizzard affecting the northern reaches, you must first investigate the mysterious stormcloud hanging still in the sky. The best place to do so would be the summit of Sentinel Peak, the mountain far to the north. Sentinel Peak Have Snow-Capped Summit in play: [guide] 1.227

name: On the Line
text:
In order to reach the structure floating within the storm, you must fire a new spiderline from the nearby stanchion.
While you are at Sentinel Peak, Spiderline Stanchion gains the following tests. Each test other than the first can only be performed once a Ranger has succeeded at the test above it. [FIT] + [reason]: Climb [1R] to the top of the stanchion. If you fail, suffer 1 injury. [AWA] + [connection]: Spot [1R] a landmark on which to latch a new line. Perform this test only if there are no non-friendly beings within reach. [SPI] + [exploration]: Visualize [1R] hitting your target. Perform this test only if you have 5 or more cards in hand. [FOC] + [conflict]: Fire [1R] the new spiderline to read [guide] 1.228a. Perform this test only if the weather is not inclement. Reach the floating island.

name: Beyond the Mist
text:
Search through the fog to discover the true purpose of this strange place. The Undergrove Arbor Mists Nimbus Facility
Response: When you clear a Deep Fog while you are at one of the above locations, draw a challenge card and resolve the effect corresponding to its challenge icon: [sun]: Scout 2 path cards. [mountain]: Move your [ranger] to another Deep Fog in play. [crest]: Shuffle this Deep Fog into the path deck instead of discarding it. While at one of the above locations, have 2 or more Deep Fogs in the path discard: [guide] 1.229
objective: While at one of the above locations, have 2 or more Deep Fogs in the path discard: [guide] 1.229
key_locations: The Undergrove, Arbor Mists, Nimbus Facility

name: Beyond the Mist
text:
Search through the fog to discover the true purpose of this strange place. The Undergrove Arbor Mists Nimbus Facility
Response: When you clear a Deep Fog while you are at one of the above locations, draw a challenge card and resolve the effect corresponding to its challenge icon: [sun]: Scout 2 path cards. [mountain]: Move your [ranger] to another Deep Fog in play. [crest]: Shuffle this Deep Fog into the path deck instead of discarding it. While at one of the above locations, have 2 or more Deep Fogs in the path discard: [guide] 1.229
objective: While at one of the above locations, have 2 or more Deep Fogs in the path discard: [guide] 1.229
key_locations: The Undergrove, Arbor Mists, Nimbus Facility

name: Ghost of a Chance
text:
Conditions around the facility are worsening by the hour. Your only hope is to somehow learn how to shut it down from the station's keeper. You've seen his spirit roaming through the Arbor Mists. Perhaps if you commune with him...
Nimbus Spirit cannot be cleared.
While Nimbus Spirit has [progress] equal to or greater than his threshold, he gains the following test: [SPI] + [conflict]: Expand [5] your consciousness to move your [ranger] to this spirit. Commit additional effort to this test equal to the number of tokens on the weather. Have all [ranger] on Nimbus Spirit: [guide] 1.230
mountain_challenge: If your [ranger] is on Nimbus Spirit, move it to an active Deep Fog.

name: Silence the Storm
text:
If left unchecked, this storm will never cease. Your only hope is to shut down the station's primary storm regulator at the Nimbus Facility.
Path Deck Assembly: If your current terrain is Nimbus, add Ball Lightning and Cerberusian Cyclone to the path deck.
Response: After a snow, funnel, mist, or electricity feature leaves play, add 1 power to Storm Regulator. Have no power on Storm Regulator: Sever the current. [guide] 1.231A Have 6+R power on Storm Regulator: Overcharge the machinery. [guide] 1.231B
objective: Have no power on Storm Regulator: [guide] 1.231A / Have 6+R power on Storm Regulator: [guide] 1.231B
sun_challenge: If there are no active snow, funnel, mist, or electricity features, search the path deck for the next one and put it into play.
crest_challenge: If Storm Regulator has 5 or more power, <f>it overloads!</f> [right_arrow] Suffer 1 injury unless you spend 1 [AWA].

name: The Other Side
text:
Deep in the Otherwoods, you found another yeti. It seems to need your help tracking down the Tenebrae for some inscrutable purpose.
Path Deck Assembly: If you are not arriving at The Otherwoods, search the Valley set for The Tenebrae and shuffle it into the path deck.
If The Tenebrae is in play and is the only path card in its area, it gains the following test: [FOC] + [reason]: Deploy [2] the device the yeti gave you to read [guide] 1.236.
mountain_challenge: Move The Tenebrae to the area with the most path cards.
crest_challenge: If The Tenebrae is active, it fatigues you unless you spend 1 [SPI]. If it is inactive, suffer 1 fatigue from its haunting sound.

name: Crossing Over
text:
With the Tenebrae in tow, you must make your way back to the heart of the Otherwoods.
The Tenebrae gains persistent.
If The Tenebrae and Transdimensional Rift are both in play, this mission gains: Refresh: Look at 3 random challenge cards attached to Transdimensional Rift. If all 3 have the same challenge icon, read [guide] 1.237. Help the yeti by bringing The Tenebrae back to the rift in The Otherwoods.
objective: Help the yeti by bringing The Tenebrae back to the rift in The Otherwoods.
mountain_challenge: Move The Tenebrae to the area with Transdimensional Rift.

name: True Colors
text:
Viv Terra has informed you of a ghostly elk she's seen in the woods, composed entirely of scintillating light. She's tasked you with tracking it down and discovering its true nature.
Shimmers are features with 0 presence and the following test: [FOC] + [exploration]: Follow [2] the trail left by the elk to set this shimmer aside. Have 2R or more shimmers set aside: [guide] 1.232
objective: Have 2R or more shimmers set aside: [guide] 1.232
sun_challenge: If you are at a non-pivotal location, place the top card of your Ranger deck facedown within reach, as a shimmer.
crest_challenge: For each shimmer within reach, either draw it into your hand or suffer 1 fatigue.

name: Battle of Wills
text:
You've tracked down the elk. Now it's up to you to unveil the truth of this strange entity.
When Prismatic Elk would be cleared by [ranger], resolve the following effect: Clear [ranger]: [guide] 1.233
[harm] or [progress] cannot be added or moved to Prismatic Elk unless all [ranger] are on it.
While all [ranger] are on Prismatic Elk, it gains the following thresholds and clear effects: Clear [harm]: Quell the entity [guide] 1.234 Clear [progress]: Help it come to terms with its existence [guide] 1.235
sun_challenge: If your [ranger] is on Prismatic Elk, return it to your role unless you spend 1 [AWA].

name: Deep Fog
text:
Untraversable.
[AWA] + [exploration]: Navigate through the fog to add [progress] to this feature equal to your effort. If you fail, move your [ranger] to this feature.
crest_challenge: If your [ranger] is on this feature, it fatigues you.

name: Viv Terra, Lodge Keeper
text:
Friendly.
[FOC] + [connection]: Call [3] forth the spirits of the wild to return a card from your hand to your collection to choose a starting spirit from your collection that you meet the aspect requirement for and add it to your hand. (This alteration to your deck is permanent.)
Clear [harm] or [progress]: [guide] 233
crest_challenge: If there are 2 or more active predators, exhaust 1 of them. [right_arrow] Add [harm] to this being equal to that predator's presence.

name: Oz Terra, Novice Hunter
text:
Friendly.
[SPI] + [conflict]: Regale Oz with tales of the hunt to exhaust an effigy attached to the location. If you do, add [progress] to this being equal to your effort plus the exhausted effigy's presence.
Clear [harm] or [progress]: [guide] 234
mountain_challenge: If there is an active predator, exhaust this being. [right_arrow] Exhaust that predator.
crest_challenge: If there is an active predator, exhaust it. [right_arrow] Add [harm] to this being equal to that predator's presence.

name: Glade of Effigies
text: [SPI] + [reason]: Record [2] an epic confrontation in the form of effigy to read [guide] 235.1.
sun_challenge: You may exhaust an effigy attached to the location. If you do, soothe 1 fatigue.

name: Cloud Generator
text: [FOC] + [reason]: Operate [2] the esoteric device to exhaust this feature and each Deep Fog in play.
sun_challenge: Exhaust this feature. [right_arrow] Search the path deck and discard for a Deep Fog and put it into play.

name: Transdimensional Rift
text:
Response: After a challenge card without [shuffle] resolves during a test other than the ones on this feature, attach it facedown to this feature, to a maximum of 5 attached cards.
[FOC] + [reason]: Study the rift to look at a number of random facedown cards attached to this feature equal to your effort and discard any number of them.
[SPI] + [conflict]: Venture [2] into the rift to read [guide] 236.4. Perform this test only if there are 2 or more challenge cards attached to this feature.

name: Entity from Afar
text:
Fatiguing.
Clear [progress]: [guide] 237
sun_challenge: If there is an odd number of [progress] on this being, <f>it vanishes.</f> [right_arrow] Shuffle it into the Otherworld deck.

name: Shimmering Eaves
text:
[SPI] + [conflict]: Venture [2] into the eerie woods to move your [ranger] to this feature. If you fail, suffer 1 fatigue.
Response: When you would draw a path card, if your [ranger] is on this feature and there are cards remaining in the Otherworld deck, draw a card from the Otherworld deck instead.

name: Storm Regulator
text:
X is the amount of power on this feature.
Response: After the weather flips, add 1 power to this feature.
[FOC] + [reason]: Manipulate [5] the device's controls to either discard 1 power from this feature or exhaust a snow, funnel, mist, or electricity feature. Commit X additional effort to this test.

name: Nimbus Spirit
text:
Friendly. Spirit.
[FOC] + [connection]: Meditate with the lonely spirit to add [progress] to the weather equal to your effort.
Response: After the weather flips, move all [progress] from it to this spirit.
Clear [progress]: [guide] 241
sun_challenge: You may suffer 1 fatigue to add 1 token to or discard 1 token from the weather.

name: Prismatic Elk
text:
[FOC] + [connection]: Comprehend [3] the nature of the entity to move your [ranger] to this being.
Response: After you interact with this being, either move it or it fatigues you.
mountain_challenge: If there is an active predator, exhaust it. [right_arrow] Add 3[harm] to that predator and [harm] to this being equal to that predator's presence.
crest_challenge: If this being has any [harm] on it, or if your [ranger] is on it, exhaust it. [right_arrow] Suffer 1 injury.

name: Remi Byrd, Hermit
text:
Friendly.
[SPI] + [reason]: Cooperate with Remi to perform another test after this one. Commit additional effort to that test equal to your effort on this test.
Clear [harm] or [progress]: [guide] 243
crest_challenge: If there is an active predator, exhaust it. [right_arrow] Add [harm] to this being equal to that predator's presence.

name: Observation Deck
text:
[SPI] + [exploration]: Marvel at the bird's-eye view of the Valley to, once per day, soothe fatigue equal to your effort.
Clear [progress]: [guide] 240.1

name: Snow-Capped Summit
text:
[FOC] + [reason]: Study [2] the clouds nearby to, once per day, add 2 tokens to or discard 2 tokens from the weather.
Clear [progress]: If all [ranger] are on a Spiderline Stanchion and you FIRED A NEW LINE, read [guide] 244.1.

name: Snowdrift
text: Obstacle.<hr>You can add a maximum of 2[progress] per test to this feature.
sun_challenge: Exhaust one of your equipped gear.

name: Remi's Treehouse
text:
While your [ranger] is on this feature, reduce any fatigue you suffer by 1, and you cannot traverse.
[FIT] + [reason]: Climb in or out of the treehouse to move your [ranger] to, or remove it from, this feature.
Response: When the travel phase begins, if all [ranger] are on this feature, you may spend a comfortable night in Remi's treehouse. Read [guide] 245.1. (This will end the day.)

name: Cloudstrider
text: Response: When this being enters play, each Ranger moves their [ranger] to the Deep Fog with the fewest [ranger] on it.
mountain_challenge: If there is an active Deep Fog, move it along the way.
crest_challenge: If your [ranger] is on a Deep Fog or Icy Path, exhaust this being. [right_arrow] Suffer 1 injury.

name: Snowtrodding Hare
text: [FIT] + [conflict]: Follow [2] the elusive hare to add 1[progress] to this being for every 2 effort. Then you may move your [ranger] to a feature or to your role.
mountain_challenge: If there is an active predator, exhaust it. [right_arrow] Add [harm] to this being equal to that predator's presence.

name: Haze Lilacs
text:
[SPI] + [reason]: Crush [2] the lilacs and take in their invigorating fume to add 1[harm] to this feature, soothe 1 fatigue, and gain 1 energy of any type.
Clear [harm]: Search the path deck and discard for a Deep Fog and put it into play.
sun_challenge: If there is [harm] on this feature, <f>mist erupts from the broken branches.</f> [right_arrow] Move your [ranger] to an active Deep Fog.
mountain_challenge: If there is an active prey, exhaust it. [right_arrow] Add [progress] to it and [harm] to this feature, both equal to that prey's presence.

name: Saber-toothed Leopard
text: While there is a Deep Fog in play, this being gains ambush.
mountain_challenge: <f>The leopard chases you into the fog.</f> Move your [ranger] to an active Deep Fog.
crest_challenge: If you have 3 or more fatigue, exhaust this being. [right_arrow] Suffer 1 injury.

name: Icy Path
text:
Dangerous.
[FOC] + [exploration]: Tread [2] carefully over the ice to move your [ranger] to this feature. If you fail, suffer 1 injury.
crest_challenge: If your [ranger] is on this feature, you start to slip. [right_arrow] Return your [ranger] to your role unless you spend 1 FIT.
